name: MonarchScreenShareView
title: ScreenShareView
summary: Shows a screen someone shares in a call, with who is presenting, fit and zoom with pan, and buttons for picture in picture and full screen that the app carries out.
whenToUse: In a call or a meeting screen, to show the screen a participant shares.
whenNotToUse: For the camera picture of a participant use a call tile. To capture and share the device's own screen use MediaProjection in the app; this view only shows a shared screen.
api: @Composable fun MonarchScreenShareView(presenterName: String, zoom: Float, onZoomChange: (Float) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, local: Boolean = false, waiting: Boolean = false, pictureInPictureActive: Boolean = false, fullScreen: Boolean = false, showControls: Boolean = true, onPictureInPicture: (() -> Unit)? = null, onFullScreen: (() -> Unit)? = null, onStopSharing: (() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchScreenShareViewLabels = MonarchScreenShareViewLabels(), video: @Composable () -> Unit)

@Composable fun MonarchScreenShareView(presenterName: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, local: Boolean = false, waiting: Boolean = false, pictureInPictureActive: Boolean = false, fullScreen: Boolean = false, showControls: Boolean = true, onPictureInPicture: (() -> Unit)? = null, onFullScreen: (() -> Unit)? = null, onStopSharing: (() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchScreenShareViewLabels = MonarchScreenShareViewLabels(), video: @Composable () -> Unit)

class MonarchScreenShareViewLabels(presenting: ((String) -> String)? = null, youArePresenting: String? = null, region: ((String) -> String)? = null, waiting: String? = null, localPreviewHidden: String? = null, showPreview: String? = null, fit: String? = null, zoomIn: String? = null, zoomOut: String? = null, zoomLevel: ((Int) -> String)? = null, pictureInPicture: String? = null, exitPictureInPicture: String? = null, fullScreen: String? = null, exitFullScreen: String? = null, stopSharing: String? = null)

options.name: presenterName
options.description: Who is sharing, as it should be read.

options.name: zoom
options.description: The zoom factor, 1 (fit) to 3; values outside are clamped. First overload; the second keeps the zoom itself.

options.name: onZoomChange
options.description: Called with the new zoom from the buttons, gestures and TalkBack actions.

options.name: local
options.description: The person using the app is sharing: the picture is hidden until asked for, and Stop sharing can be offered.

options.name: waiting
options.description: The shared screen has not arrived: a waiting text replaces the picture.

options.name: pictureInPictureActive
options.description: Switches the picture-in-picture button to its exit form and marks it selected.

options.name: fullScreen
options.description: Switches the full-screen button to its exit form and marks it selected.

options.name: showControls
options.description: Shows the zoom, picture-in-picture and full-screen buttons.

options.name: onPictureInPicture
options.description: Starts or ends picture in picture through the activity. Adds the button.

options.name: onFullScreen
options.description: Enters or leaves full screen. Adds the button.

options.name: onStopSharing
options.description: Stops sharing. Adds the button when local.

options.name: video
options.description: The picture, from the app's call SDK. It fills the 16 by 9 area.

states.name: fit
states.description: The whole picture fits the 16 by 9 area; Zoom out and Fit to view are disabled.

states.name: zoomed
states.description: The picture is larger than the area and pans by dragging; the level is shown as a percentage.

states.name: waiting
states.description: "Waiting for the shared screen…" on the inverse surface.

states.name: local, preview hidden
states.description: A notice on the subtle background with a "Show preview" button replaces the picture.

states.name: picture in picture active
states.description: The button reads "Exit picture in picture" and is marked selected.

appearance: A surface with the default border and 12dp corners. The bar holds the presenter in the default text color and ghost buttons; Stop sharing is a danger button. The picture area is the inverse surface; the notice is the subtle background with muted text. The same roles are used in every theme.
platformNotes: The web takes a MediaStream and starts browser picture in picture and full screen itself. On Android the picture is a slot for the call SDK's view, and picture in picture (Activity.enterPictureInPictureMode with PictureInPictureParams) and full screen (window insets and orientation) belong to the activity, so the app starts them through onPictureInPicture and onFullScreen; the view shows the buttons and their state, as on iOS. Zoom adds pinch and double tap to the web's buttons and steps through the same levels: 100%, 150%, 200%, 300%. The buttons are text buttons because Monarch bundles no icons. The web names the controls as a group; Compose has no named group, so the buttons are read one by one. The web keyboard shortcuts (+, -, 0) are not offered.
accessibility: The picture is one TalkBack element named "Screen shared by …" with the image role and the zoom level as its state.
TalkBack offers Zoom in and Zoom out as actions on the picture while each is possible.
The zoom level beside the buttons is a polite live region, so a level chosen with a button is announced.
The picture-in-picture and full-screen buttons are marked selected while active.
Every button has a 48dp touch target.
The content of the shared screen is not described.
edgeCases: Pinching keeps the center of the picture, not the point under the fingers.
A zoom outside 1 to 3 is clamped.
At zoom 1 drags are not taken, so the screen around the view still scrolls.
When the controls do not fit one row they wrap below the presenter.
With local and waiting the notice has no "Show preview" button.
TalkBack cannot pan the zoomed picture.
